metadata.question: Was the surface color of Lake Ijssel near Kornwerderzand visibly greener than near Afsluitdijk on July 8, 2023?

data.raw_code: The user wants to compare surface color (greenness) of Lake Ijssel at two locations on July 8, 2023. This is about water color analysis, so I should: 1. Use Sentinel-2 imagery which has good spatial resolution and visible bands 2. Define the two locations as points with buffers 3. Focus on July 8, 2023 specifically 4. Use a greenness index - NDVI would work well for vegetation, but for water color analysis, I could use: - NDVI to detect vegetation/chlorophyll in water - Or simply compare the green band reflectance - Or use a water quality index like NDWI or chlorophyll index I'll use NDVI as it's a good indicator of green vegetation/algae in water. Strategy: 1. Create points for Kornwerderzand and Afsluitdijk with buffers 2. Get Sentinel-2 imagery for July 8, 2023 3. Apply cloud masking 4. Calculate NDVI for both locations 5. Compare the mean NDVI values 6. Check for data availability and valid pixels Let me define the approximate coordinates: - Kornwerderzand: (53.071, 5.339) - Afsluitdijk: (53.027, 5.178) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const kornwerderzand = ee.Geometry.Point([5.339, 53.071]).buffer(500); // Near Kornwerderzand const afsluitdijk = ee.Geometry.Point([5.178, 53.027]).buffer(500); // Near Afsluitdijk const date = '2023-07-08'; // 2. Data Acquisition let s2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')) .filterBounds(ee.Geometry.Point([5.258, 53.049])) // Center of area .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)); let imageCount = s2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Sentinel-2 images on ${date}: ${imageCount}`); if (imageCount === 0) { console.log("No images found for exact date, trying ±3 days"); s2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterDate('2023-07-05', '2023-07-11') .filterBounds(ee.Geometry.Point([5.258, 53.049])) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)); imageCount = s2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Sentinel-2 images in ±3 day window: ${imageCount}`); if (imageCount === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } } // Get best image (least cloudy) const image = s2.sort('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE').first(); // 3. Processing - Calculate NDVI for greenness const ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); // 4. Extract values for both locations const kornwerderzandStats = ndvi.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: kornwerderzand, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const afsluitdijkStats = ndvi.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: afsluitdijk, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const kornData = kornwerderzandStats.getInfo(); const afslData = afsluitdijkStats.getInfo(); console.log(`Kornwerderzand - NDVI: ${kornData.NDVI_mean?.toFixed(4)}, Pixels: ${kornData.NDVI_count}`); console.log(`Afsluitdijk - NDVI: ${afslData.NDVI_mean?.toFixed(4)}, Pixels: ${afslData.NDVI_count}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (kornData.NDVI_count === 0 || afslData.NDVI_count === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } if (kornData.NDVI_mean === null || afslData.NDVI_mean === null || isNaN(kornData.NDVI_mean) || isNaN(afslData.NDVI_mean)) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare NDVI values - higher NDVI means greener if (kornData.NDVI_mean > afslData.NDVI_mean) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
